pb-seller-guides.meesho.step1: Get the current permitted catalogue template from your own Meesho account. Do not infer its columns.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.step2: In Seller operations, choose Catalogue sheet and Meesho. Add the product CSV and a header-to-field map, template source and checked date.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.step3: Review the generated sheet, then upload or copy it yourself in the seller dashboard.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.skipped: A template older than ninety days, a missing field or duplicate column refuses. Formula-shaped input stays text; no vendor validation or acceptance is claimed.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.checks: Chausar validates the supplied mapping and bounded text rows locally. It does not sign in or test seller account access.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.sends: Sends: nothing. You upload or copy the reviewed sheet yourself.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.agentLimits: Agents cannot log in, upload a catalogue, change a price or send a message on their own.
pb-seller-guides.meesho.charges: Check current seller account and provider fees yourself. No platform price or free plan is promised.

pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.step1: In the Shopify Dev Dashboard, create an app in the same organization as your own shop, request only the scopes used here and install it in that shop.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.step2: For catalogue and variant reads use read_products, read_inventory and read_locations. Price and title changes also need write_products; stock movement also needs write_inventory.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.step3: Open Seller connections in the desktop or hosted app. Enter the exact myshopify.com shop, app client ID and secret, owner caps and own-store confirmation. Approve connection, then read the exact product and location.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.step4: Prepare one exact change, read its source receipt and approve it separately. A new session requires connecting again.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.skipped: This client-credentials route only serves an app and shop in the same organization. Other merchants require a separately qualified authorization route. No public app review or live store qualification is claimed.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.checks: The connection checks the exact returned shop. A write is successful only after its response and exact read-back agree. Unknown outcomes require inspection in Shopify and cannot be resent.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.sends: Sends: the exact approved token, read or single product change request to your Shopify shop. Credentials stay in session memory.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.agentLimi: Agents cannot approve a write, exceed the owner caps, change the account or retry an uncertain write.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-admin.charges: Check current seller account and provider fees yourself. No platform price or free plan is promised.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-storefront.step: Create a public Storefront token in your own Shopify shop with public product listing access. Keep private Admin credentials out of this field.
Open Store assistant in Seller connections. Select a connected API model, a bounded page limit, buyer language and purpose notice. Approve that exact catalogue read.
Buyer access still waits for named legal confirmation. After it is confirmed, approve opening the hosted assistant. Approve each exact buyer question, model and maximum cost separately.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-storefront.skip: A catalogue expires after fifteen minutes and needs a fresh approved read. A partial catalogue never yields a complete total. Desktop links to the shop; the buyer widget requires hosting.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-storefront.chec: Chausar reads the actual public catalogue. It checks model output against current product IDs and code prices. No order is placed and no live account qualification is claimed.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-storefront.send: Sends: only approved public reads, then separately approved buyer questions and public catalogue data to the chosen API model. Provider retention follows the owner account terms.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-storefront.agen: Agents cannot blanket-approve future questions, retain buyer text beyond the session, invent a price, charge a buyer or place an order.
pb-seller-guides.shopify-storefront.char: Check your current provider plan. Every later paid AI question has its own computed quote and owner approval.
